templates.text: A light stroke on the cheek → a faint, delayed rooting motion, then stillness.
Sudden air current on the face → a slow, partial grimace, no sustained cry.
Cotton ball brushed on sole → toes curl weakly after a {delay} second pause.
Palmar touch → fingers make a feeble, incomplete grasp, then release.
Brief cold touch to abdomen → a sluggish, shallow startle with muted limbs.
Gentle hair tug → a low, breathy whimper that fades within moments.
Nape stroked → head turns slightly, then drifts back, movement aborted.
Heel pressed → leg draws up slowly, extension phase is absent.
Lip touched with fingertip → a weak suckle attempt, mouth falls open.
Sudden fabric rustle near ear → eyes blink slowly, no orienting turn.
Light pressure on forehead → brows furrow faintly, expression dissolves.
Tickle under the chin → jaw quivers briefly, no coordinated avoidance.
Wipe across the brow → a sigh-like exhalation, no further motor response.
Pinprick to the heel → a delayed, low-intensity jerk, cry is a thin mewl.
Hand placed in palm → fingers close limply, grip fails to sustain.
Cheek stroked towards mouth → head lags, turns {angle} degrees before stopping.
Sudden drop of a few centimeters → arms flail weakly, Moro is fragmentary.
Rib cage lightly tapped → a shallow, sighing breath, no startle cascade.
Foot sole stroked → Babinski sign is equivocal, toes barely fan.
Nostril brushed with wisp → head turns away sluggishly, then relents.
Gentle shake of the crib → eyes open wide for a moment, then glaze over.
Cool metal on the back → a shiver runs through the torso, poorly localized.
Finger drawn along spine → trunk arches minimally, response is truncated.
Eyelid lightly touched → blink is slow and incomplete, lid remains partly open.
Arm pulled gently → offers minimal resistance, muscle tone seems to ebb.
Sudden pat on the diaper → a brief, quiet grunt, limbs remain flaccid.
Light scratch on the scalp → a faint frown, followed by apathetic stillness.
Toe squeezed → the leg retracts feebly, withdrawal reflex is blunted.
Cheek blown on softly → a slight pucker, sucking motion is not initiated.
Palms rubbed together → hands remain passive, no reciprocal grasping effort.
